title: EnvelopeFile in relay_queue.rs missing Debug derive
description: relay_queue.rs EnvelopeFile struct derives Serialize and Deserialize but not Debug. Idiomatic Rust derives Debug on essentially all non-public types unless there is a specific reason to suppress it (e.g. the type holds secrets). EnvelopeFile contains mail_from and rcpt_to strings — these are logged elsewhere anyway (as warn!/info! messages), so omitting Debug just makes test assertions and log-format debugging harder with no security benefit. The paired NntpEnvelope in queue.rs correctly derives Debug.
